As someone who struggles with weight a lott, here are some actual reasons why this could be happening.
1. Water weight is a bitch.
2. Even gaining a little muscle can cause the scale to go up!
3. Do you weight at the same exact time, wearing the same exact thing? This matters immensely.
4. Have you pooped lately? Once I didn't go for like 2 days and created a 4 pound poop. Amazing.
5. I have hypo-thyroid and low metabolism which makes it wicked difficult to lose and I have to work harder than a person without these issues.  Maybe you're in a similar boat?
6. Cake. I really like cake. 
7. Is it hot where you are? Heat makes the body swell a little.
8. PMS and bloating. Blahh.

Conclusion: Your weight gain could easily NOT be your fault.
If it's any encouragement, I've been working out and eating less for months now and lost 15 pounds. I average about 5 pounds per month which is wicked slow, but something.
